exposure: maternal morbidity at the time of the previous CS
cohort: The study included 341 women with at least one prior cesarean section.
finding: A predictive model was developed that can predict the severity of post-CS adhesions with 79.1% accuracy based on factors like the number of previous CS, BMI, maternal morbidity at prior CS, and operation time.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was identified as a significant predictor for the severity of intra-abdominal adhesions.
